title: Aalto University Science Institute International Summer Research Programme
level: Bachelor's and master's students (doctoral students in exceptional cases)
about: 12-week on-site summer research internship (June-August 2027) at Aalto University for bachelor's, master's and, exceptionally, doctoral students worldwide. Applicants choose up to three projects; projects are listed mid-December and applications open 7 January 2027.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Field "Science and engineering research" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Audience "Bachelor's and master's students (doctoral students in exceptional cases)" on a "12-week on-site summer research internship" → objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
